name: Eutin (Germany)
description: Blue field charged with the yellow cross with fleur-de-lis ends and two roses of the city arms of Eutin.
history: Municipal flag of Eutin; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: cross with fleur-de-lis ends and roses from the city arms
